kind: Local exact destination promotion-group browser read

observations: The signed promotion over Bandit commits both destinations and one binding. Both exact destination selectors return the same two receipts through the ordinary browser cookie path.

The original sequences remain iOS 3 and Android 12 after separately publishing Android 13 and iOS 4. Historical lookups return the advanced head sequences. The Android 13 publication has no promotion group.

A viewer with mixer.workspace.read sees both receipts. An authenticated org-b owner receives 404 for both org-a selectors. Deactivating the destination denies both lookups. Deactivating the source denies its own head, while the destination group remains identical and destination-only.
A missing cookie returns 401. Invalid or unbounded selectors return 400. Well-formed misses return 404. Legacy browser responses and the signed promotion retry were compared.

The function owner, stable execution, fixed search path and grants matched the tested contract. The restricted ordinary API login has EXECUTE. The lifecycle and helper roles and PUBLIC lack EXECUTE. Migration admission checks FORCE RLS on all three relations.
A PostgreSQL 18 version stub returned exit 2 before cluster creation.
